|lore=Located atop the superstructure of a Star Destroyer, the generator towers create an energy shield which repels solid objects and weapons fire.
|game_text=Deploy on a Star Destroyer. Starship is power +2, immune to attrition < 3, and may not be targeted by opponent’s Interrupts or starship weapons. Star Destroyers are destiny +1. Your Force generation here is +1. During your deploy phase, may deploy a TIE here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
